title: Mitigating Source Bias for Fairer Weak Supervision
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and mitigating source bias in weak supervision. Although it utilizes labeling functions defined by religious keywords (e.g., 'muslim', 'christian', 'god') for specific NLP datasets to evaluate demographic parity gaps, the core of the work is a technical method for bias mitigation rather than a benchmark or evaluation of religion, theology, or moral systems.
